description: This header file defines classes and methods for implementing PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) controllers in a firmware project, including both a standard PID class and a cascaded integrator-comb (CIC) variant.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: A class implementing a basic PID controller with methods for initialization, calculation, resetting, and state display.

classes.name: PidCic
classes.description: A subclass of Pid implementing a PID with a modified cascaded integrator-comb filtering approach for incremental auto-IAC control.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Default constructor for the Pid class.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Constructor for Pid class with initialization from a pid_s structure.

methods.name: initPidClass
methods.description: Initializes the PID class from a pid_s structure.

methods.name: isSame
methods.description: Checks if the provided pid_s structure matches the current PID configuration.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates the PID output based on target and input values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates the PID output with a specified delta time, for internal use.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw PID output without limiting, for incremental CIC PID use.

methods.name: updateFactors
methods.description: Updates the PID gains (P, I, D factors).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the PID state.

methods.name: getP
methods.description: Returns the proportional gain.

methods.name: getI
methods.description: Returns the integral gain.

methods.name: getD
methods.description: Returns the derivative gain.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value.

methods.name: getIntegration
methods.description: Returns the integrated value.

methods.name: getPrevError
methods.description: Returns the previous error value.

methods.name: setErrorAmplification
methods.description: Sets the error amplification coefficient.

methods.name: postState
methods.description: Outputs the PID state to TunerStudio, conditional on the build flags.

methods.name: showPidStatus
methods.description: Displays the current status of the PID for debugging.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses or puts the PID into a sleep state.

methods.name: resetCounter
methods.description: Counter for PID reset occurrences.

methods.name: updateITerm
methods.description: Updates the integral term based on the current value.

methods.name: PidCic
methods.description: Constructor for the PidCic subclass.

methods.name: PidCic
methods.description: Constructor with initialization from a pid_s structure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the PidCic internal state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates the PID output using the CIC filtering method.

methods.name: updateITerm
methods.description: Overrides to update the I-term with CIC filtering.
